fallback: The strongest internal dialogue in this chart describes two important needs learning how to share space. At times, they may support one another easily; at other times, they may ask for different pacing, priorities, or forms of care. Neither side needs to be treated as a problem. The value of this pattern lies in the information created when both are taken seriously. Notice where one impulse rushes ahead, where another asks for more time, and what becomes possible when the response includes both. Integration is less about perfect balance than about building a life where your capacities do not have to compete for permission to exist.
